strategy.preferred: Use pip-build-core plus native-libs-* profiles so users keep the normal pip install workflow.
strategy.fallback: Use prebuilt-python-* profiles when Android builds are too slow, unreliable, or unsuitable for end users.
strategy.heavyFallback: Keep pip-build-rust and prebuilt-python-ai-ml explicit because they are large and more likely to exceed CI or device limits.

profileGroups.title: Pip Build Runtime
profileGroups.description: Recommended default set: pip build tools plus native dependency libraries, without heavy Rust tooling or prebuilt Python modules.

profileGroups.title: Prebuilt Python Fallback
profileGroups.description: Fallback set of prebuilt Python modules for packages that are slow or fragile to compile on device.

profileGroups.title: All Non-AI Extensions
profileGroups.description: Standard native dependency packs plus non-AI prebuilt fallback packs.

profileGroups.title: All Extensions Including AI
profileGroups.description: Everything in all, plus the heavy AI/ML prebuilt fallback profile.

profiles.title: Pip Build Core
profiles.description: Pip, compilers, make, CMake, Ninja, pkg-config, pybind11, and common native headers.

profiles.title: Rust Pip Build Tools
profiles.description: Heavy Rust-based build tools for Python packages that use Rust extensions or uv.

profiles.title: Scientific Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native numeric libraries commonly needed by NumPy, SciPy, sparse solvers, HDF5, NetCDF, and scientific wheels.

profiles.title: Data Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native data storage and interchange libraries for DuckDB, Arrow, ORC, HDF5, NetCDF, SQLite, YAML, XML, and Zstd.

profiles.title: Image Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, OpenJPEG, FreeType, Fontconfig, GraphicsMagick, Leptonica, and Tesseract dependencies.

profiles.title: Visualization Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native Cairo, Pango, Graphviz, and Gnuplot libraries used by plotting and rendering packages.

profiles.title: XML / HTML Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native XML, HTML, YAML, tree-sitter, cleanup, and XML security dependencies.

profiles.title: Crypto / Network Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native OpenSSL, libffi, libsodium, SSH, curl, HTTP/2, protobuf, gRPC, Kerberos, and c-ares dependencies.

profiles.title: Media Native Libraries
profiles.description: Native audio/video libraries including ffmpeg, FLAC, Ogg, Vorbis, Opus, TagLib, SoX, and common image codecs.

profiles.title: Prebuilt Scientific Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python numeric packages for fallback installs when compiling scientific packages on device is not practical.

profiles.title: Prebuilt Data Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python packages for data processing, serialization, storage, and compression fallback installs.

profiles.title: Prebuilt Image Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python image packages such as Pillow and related fallback modules.

profiles.title: Prebuilt Visualization Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python plotting and visualization fallback modules.

profiles.title: Prebuilt XML / HTML Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python XML, HTML, and parsing fallback modules.

profiles.title: Prebuilt Crypto / Network Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python cryptography, bcrypt, PyCryptodomeX, and gRPC fallback modules.

profiles.title: Prebuilt Media Python
profiles.description: Prebuilt Python media fallback modules that pair with audio/video native libraries.

profiles.title: Prebuilt AI / ML Python
profiles.description: Heavy prebuilt AI/ML fallback packages such as Torch, TorchVision, TorchAudio, TFLite Runtime, and ONNX Runtime.
